description: The official MM baseline, universe, version and conditions remain unverified. The available codebook was consulted; no official update is authorized.
required_followup: Coordinator must verify the official baseline and eligibility universe before any integration.

description: Open-web discovery is not the original LexisNexis method. Generic, weekly, sector, regional, Spanish and English searches and December/February boundary checks found leads, but coverage is uneven and not exhaustive.
required_followup: Use licensed systematic archives where authorized and extend underrepresented regional coverage; retain method differences.

description: El Quijote counts about 10 motorcyclists, more than 25 coachdrivers and an unnumbered truckdriver fleet; the total does not establish 50 simultaneous demonstrators.
required_followup: Find an explicit crowd total or additional original visual/reporting evidence; do not count vehicles as people.

description: Holguín siblings' arrests on January 6–7 and the monthly list's January 7 description do not identify a public protest date, size, demand or clearly linked state response.
required_followup: Locate the original protest account; establish physical gathering date, domestic target and attendance separately from arrest dates.

description: UNPACU January 14 public-road protest and January 15 headquarters protest have no crowd totals. A shared cordon or organizational campaign does not prove one continuous physical assembly.
required_followup: Seek original incident accounts and determine separate assemblies versus continuity using the missing detailed Procedure when available.

description: The January 15 UNPACU account says activists protested at headquarters without establishing whether this was public space or a private-home gathering. Food-access grievance and political detention context require separate attribution.
required_followup: Verify accessible public location, participants and domestic-state demand before inclusion.

description: Niubis Bisset's arrest on leaving headquarters is reported after the January 15 protest, but whether it was a response to that gathering or the wider cordon remains unresolved.
required_followup: Confirm the event-specific link; the current arrests=yes is a provisional attributed coding subject to review.

description: Jobabo charcoal workers are mentioned as joining a stoppage without their number, date, public assembly or precise target. The separate main-site count is 22 and cannot be transferred or summed across sites.
required_followup: Obtain a Jobabo original account; establish first physical assembly, public character, crowd and domestic policy demand.

description: Charcoal reports have a search-only January 15 lead, a January 19 original report and later wording suggesting a January 19 start. January 26 return applies to the reported Las Tunas group, not automatically Jobabo.
required_followup: Open the earlier original account and reconcile the first physical action and actual closure, retaining discrepancies.

description: IACC flight buyers gathered during the week ending January 15 and returned later; reports say numerous people or dozens. Thousands of affected ticket buyers are not attendance. First day, 50 threshold, repeat-visit boundaries and final closure are unverified.
required_followup: Verify simultaneous attendance and first physical gathering date; distinguish separate visits from continuous assembly and document actual closure.

description: IACC account documents actual reception by IACC and transport officials, supporting accommodation. Police monitoring and threats around an intended Plaza move do not by themselves prove dispersal or arrests.
required_followup: Retain the formal reception evidence; require a concrete event-specific act for any additional response category.

description: The La Palma account names three demonstrators and says a crowd followed. Whether followers joined the demands, and whether at least 50 participated, is unknown.
required_followup: Find an original attendance account distinguishing participants from spectators and police.

description: The CCDDHH monthly report mentions Bahía/Antonio Guiteras shelter residents protesting housing, water and food prices, without an exact January date, crowd size, precise site or original source. Demand taxonomy also needs review.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous original reporting and establish public assembly, date, target, size and supported demand categories.

description: Migrated elTOQUE headers conflict with article chronology: the November 2020 assembly has a January header; the Santa Clara article describes March rather than January; January 27 chronology also has a conflicting header. Publication and occurrence dates remain separate.
required_followup: Use original publication metadata/archive evidence when available; do not assign event dates from migrated headers.

description: Cubalex returned HTTP429 and the CID PDF HTTP406. Six public pages produced web-tool internal/cache failures; ordinary HTTPS fallback to those same URLs then failed environmental DNS resolution, not confirmed publisher denial.
required_followup: Retry ordinary authorized access in a functioning environment; do not evade publisher controls. Preserve search-only status until body verification.

description: Martí reports are reused or cited by other outlets, weekly 14ymedio copies repeat its own originals, and FDP/UNPACU and CCDDHH reports contain attributed organizational claims. Granma's official characterizations and opposition descriptions are distinct accounts, not independent proof of every allegation.
required_followup: Trace each substantive claim to its origin; deduplicate syndication and retain attribution when reviewing fields.

description: Unreported state-response categories and protester violence remain unknown. A grievance about repression, a cumulative detention total, near violence or police presence does not establish violence or all seven responses to the indexed gathering.
required_followup: Verify every affirmative response and violence code against the specific gathering; preserve unknown where evidence is absent.

description: November 27N campaigning, December Havana-port action and December pork sellers' stoppage are boundary context, not proven January continuations. February aggregates do not establish January events. The additional detailed Procedure for episode boundaries is unavailable.
required_followup: Coordinator should route pre-January evidence to the owning unit and review any continuity only with physical-action evidence and the recovered Procedure.

description: The first four query timestamps were not retained and remain null rather than reconstructed clocks. The first two searches were returned in one batch, so their logged URL set is shared. Source accessed_at records the actual review/discovery checkpoint where exact individual-open times were not separately retained.
required_followup: Preserve these logging limitations; use exact contemporaneous per-query clocks in any further research.
